temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual. When Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is just personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Before noticing her withdrawal, Jose had no specific concern about Patricia's well-being and sees her as usually vibrant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — his vague suspicion that something is troubling Patricia is strengthened, though the cause remains unspecified.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be dealing with a personal problem; she appreciates Jose's concern but is not ready to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to listen and be available if Patricia wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, she confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose suspects Patricia may be dealing with personal trouble and appreciates his concern, but he does not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — his concern becomes more specific: he now believes financial stress is a concrete issue for Patricia and that she may accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed about finances and is willing to discuss budgeting or financial planning with him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and motivated to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to go over budgeting tips or financial planning together when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she did not think he was prying, says she is grateful he offered to help, and states it is good to know she has someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is under financial stress and accepted his offer, but he worries he may have overstepped by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Patricia's reassurance reduces his worry that he crossed a boundary.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he overstepped; she appreciates his support and sees him as a friend she can turn to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while respecting her privacy and not prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds casually that everything is all good and she plans a quiet weekend at home. She does not share more about personal or financial issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support, does not consider him intrusive, and may still be dealing with financial or personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he interprets her brief response as a sign that she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his concern but wants privacy; he should remain available without pushing her to open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a supportive presence without pressuring her, letting her know he is available if needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him it is really great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates support but prefers privacy and may still be dealing with personal or financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he sees that Patricia is managing her situation and values his low-pressure supportive check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but coping, and she appreciates his continued support; he can keep being available in a friendly, non-intrusive way.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular low-pressure check-ins and offer small forms of help, such as grabbing coffee, while respecting her privacy.
